products.title: ColorPro VP2776T-4K Monitor
products.description: The ViewSonic ColorPro VP2776T-4K is a 27-inch 4K HDR monitor designed for professionals. It features a 16:9 IPS panel with 3840 x 2160 UHD resolution, providing crisp visuals and a wide 178° viewing angle. The monitor is Pantone validated and factory calibrated for high color accuracy (Delta <2), covering 98% of the DCI-P3 and 89% of the Adobe RGB color gamuts. It offers versatile connectivity with Thunderbolt 4, dual HDMI 2.1, and DisplayPort 1.4, including an integrated dock with a 2.5GbE Ethernet port and various USB ports. Additional features include VESA HDR400 certification, built-in 3W stereo speakers, and an ergonomic stand that supports height, tilt, swivel, and 90° rotation.

products.title: Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH LED Monitor
products.description: The Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH is a 27-inch 4K UHD LED monitor designed for detailed visuals and multitasking. It features a 3840 x 2160 resolution IPS panel with 350 cd/m² brightness, a 1000:1 static contrast ratio, and HDR10 support for enhanced color and contrast. products.title: Dell 27 Plus 4k USB-C Monitor
products.description: The Dell 27 Plus 4K USB-C Monitor (S2725QC) is a 27-inch LED monitor featuring a 4K UHD resolution (3840 x 2160) and a refresh rate of up to 120Hz. It utilizes In-Plane Switching (IPS) technology to deliver vivid colors with 99% sRGB coverage and a 1500:1 contrast ratio. Designed for both productivity and entertainment, it includes dual 5W speakers, AMD FreeSync Premium for tear-free gaming, and a 4-star TÜV Rheinland eye comfort certification with ComfortView Plus to reduce blue light emissions. Connectivity is streamlined via a USB-C port that supports up to 65W power delivery, alongside HDMI 2.1 ports and USB-A downstream ports. The monitor is highly adjustable, offering height, pivot, swivel, and tilt options, and is constructed with sustainable materials, including recycled plastic, aluminium, and steel.

products.title: Sony Spatial Reality Display ELF-SR2 - LED monitor - 4K - 27"
products.description: The Sony 27" 4K Spatial Reality Display (ELF-SR2) is a professional-grade monitor that provides an immersive 3D optical experience without the need for 3D glasses or a VR headset. Utilizing Sony's Eye-Sensing Light Field Display (ELFD) technology and a high-speed vision sensor, the display tracks the user's eyes in real-time to render 3D objects relative to their position. It features a 4K resolution (3840 x 2160) LCD panel with HDR support, 1.07 billion colors, and 100% Adobe RGB and DCI-P3 color gamuts. The display is designed for high-end CAD, medical, architecture, and engineering applications, with native compatibility for Unity, Unreal Engine, and NVIDIA Omniverse.
